data.name: SLS Cancun
data.address: Boulevard Kukulcan Km 1 Zona Turistica Puerto Cancun, 77500 Cancún, Q.R., Mexico
data.description:
This posh beachfront resort along the Caribbean Sea is 9 km from El Meco Archaeological Site and 19 km from Cancún International Airport.
Featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, the chic rooms offer Wi-Fi and TVs, plus coffeemakers, minibars and sitting areas. Upgraded rooms add balconies and sea views, and 1- and 2-bedroom suites have separate living rooms.
There's a fashionable Argentinean grill restaurant, as well as a lobby bar, and a beach bar and grill with fire pits and daybeds. Other amenities include a spa, a gym and a private beach club, along with outdoor pools. Breakfast and parking are available.
